name: Phantom Nightmare
description: A phantom dragon Bey that absorbs punishment into spectral energy, then returns the stored force as a delayed echo.

ability.name: Phantom Energy
ability.description: Stores 20% of real HP damage received as Phantom Energy, up to 60 stored damage. After 2 turns, 50% of the currently stored damage is released as a protected delayed secondary hit, then that released amount is removed from storage.

abilities.name: Phantom Energy
abilities.description: Stores 20% of real HP damage received as Phantom Energy, up to 60 stored damage. After 2 turns, 50% of the currently stored damage is released as a protected delayed secondary hit, then that released amount is removed from storage.

abilities.name: Phantom Dragon
abilities.description: Phantom Dragon heals Phantom Nightmare for 25% of the actual HP damage dealt by the Special.

special_move.name: 🐉 Phantom Dragon
special_move.description: Phantom Nightmare unleashes its spectral dragon in a finishing strike. Deals 160 base damage plus 45% ATK scaling and heals for 25% of the actual HP damage dealt.
flavour_texts: 🐉 **Phantom Dragon** — spectral jaws tear through the arena!
